page.overview:
Who is Alexandra Danvers?

R. Labs agent under the command of Superman in an alternate reality. R. Labs who served under the rule of Deegan himself that was transformed into Superman. R. Labs' pipeline.

Kara tried to convince her about the reality changes, telling her about events from her childhood in her home reality: Alex was shocked to recognize these memories and realized that Superman was an imposter that altered the universe so she decided to release the Kryptonian prisoner.

Superman confronted Alex after she freed Supergirl, trying to eliminate her but the agent was saved by Barry Allen, Oliver Queen and Mr. Ramon.

Alex also tried to attack Barry as, in the altered reality, he was a member of the villainous Trigger Twins along with Oliver, but was stopped by Kara that revelead her the truth.

entity.description:
Alex Danvers is a S.T.A.R. Labs agent under the command of Superman in an alternate reality.

After John Deegan altered Earth-1's reality using the Book of Destiny, Alexandra "Alex" Danvers became an agent of the S.T.A.R. Labs who served under the rule of Deegan himself that was transformed into Superman.

Alex Danvers was ordered to control Kara Zor-El aka Supergirl who was depowered by Deegan and imprisoned in the S.T.A.R. Labs' pipeline. Kara tried to convince her about the reality changes, telling her about events from her childhood in her home reality: Alex was shocked to recognize these memories and realized that Superman was an imposter that altered the universe so she decided to release the Kryptonian prisoner.

Superman confronted Alex after she freed Supergirl, trying to eliminate her but the agent was saved by Barry Allen, Oliver Queen and Mr. Ramon. Alex also tried to attack Barry as, in the altered reality, he was a member of the villainous Trigger Twins along with Oliver, but was stopped by Kara that revelead her the truth.
